steps.title: Privilege gateway model routes
steps.what: On the OpenAI and Anthropic routes, the gateway's own refusals (401, 403, 400, 429) are described as short JSON bodies that name the cause; only the guardrail block body was reproduced across providers, and provider errors come back in the provider's own style.
steps.why: Applications built for different provider APIs should not each need their own governance.

steps.title: Eleven providers, twelve routes
steps.what: The Ping deck (LLM Gateway) counts eleven providers across twelve routes that the deck describes as verified, with Bedrock runtime and Mantle as separate routes: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, xAI, Groq, Mistral, DeepSeek, Together and OpenRouter.
